name: Face Coverage Mask Culling
definition: A method for culling faces of partial shapes (stairs, slabs, etc.) by representing face coverage as a bit mask. It solves the problem where a boolean solid flag is insufficient because partial shapes have mixed visible/hidden areas on a single face.
summary: Face Coverage Mask Culling removes hidden faces of partial voxel shapes by using 16-bit bitmasks to represent sub-face coverage, enabling precise culling at sub-face granularity unlike coarse block visibility methods.
